ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.15 ratio of high-intensity pixels (white) concentrated in the lateral distal lobes to low-intensity pixels (black/dark-grey) localized in the central peduncle-base region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two dominant high-intensity white zones occupy the outer 60% of each lobe. The boundary between the central dark zone and lateral white zones is defined by high-frequency black mottling and stippling (coordinates concentrated in the medial-distal quadrant).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 122 degrees; depth is roughly 8% of the maximum fluke chord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with vertical amplitudes ranging from 2 to 14 pixels. Notable macro-indentations are visible at the distal third of the right lobe's edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending distally, transitioning into an upward-sloping, tapered tip on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of high-contrast, textured pixel clusters (likely barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe; sparse circular dark spots (pixels < 40 intensity) are scattered across the white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal low-intensity streak (approx. 45-degree angle) visible on the medial-left lobe; multiple shorter vertical and sub-vertical linear marks present on the medial-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular textural mass on the terminal point of the left lobe; multiple small-scale indentations along the trailing edge indicating minor tissue loss or structural trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'feathered' stippling effect at the pigment interface, characterized by a high-contrast spray of dark pixels into the white field, particularly prominent on the inner-ventral right lobe.
